class.name: HTMLElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an element in a parsed HTML layout.
class.description: Obtain a handle from [method HTMLLayout.query_selector] or [method HTMLLabel.query_selector]. A handle belongs to one layout and stays valid across viewport resizes. While a handle is held, querying or hitting the same element in that layout returns the same object. Parsing again, clearing the layout, or freeing its owner invalidates it. An invalid handle returns empty results or the supplied attribute default. Use these methods on the main thread. Edits affect this layout only. Other views of the same [HTMLDocument] and the source resource are unaffected. Queries and attribute reads see edits immediately. Geometry is available after the next layout pass. [HTMLLabel] batches edits and emits [signal HTMLLabel.layout_changed] when the new layout is ready. A standalone [HTMLLayout] with a previous viewport reflows on a deferred call, or can be laid out immediately with [method HTMLLayout.layout]. Editing methods return [constant OK] on success and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid handle or invalid arguments.

method.name: add_class
method.description: Adds a case-sensitive class name if it is absent. The name must be a single non-empty token without ASCII whitespace.

method.name: append_child
method.description: Appends [param child] to the end of this element's children and preserves the subtree's handles. Accepts both unattached elements from [method HTMLLayout.create_element] and existing elements from the same layout. Cycles, moving the document root, and inserting elements into tags that cannot contain them are rejected.

method.name: closest
method.description: Returns the closest matching ancestor, starting with this element. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element. Returns [code]null[/code] if nothing matches.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns the attribute value, or [param default_value] if the attribute is absent. Attribute names are ASCII case-insensitive. An explicitly empty attribute returns an empty string.

method.name: get_attributes
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the element's HTML attributes. Keys and values are strings. An explicitly empty attribute has an empty string value.

method.name: get_bounding_rect
method.description: Returns the union of the rectangles from [method get_client_rects], or an empty rectangle if there are no boxes.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns the direct child elements in document order. Text nodes, comments, and CSS-generated pseudo-elements are excluded.

method.name: get_class_list
method.description: Returns the class names in attribute order. Class names are case-sensitive and appear once in the result.

method.name: get_client_rects
method.description: Returns the element's border-box fragments in document pixel coordinates, before clipping or label scrolling. An inline element may have multiple rectangles. The array is empty before layout or when the element has no layout box.

method.name: get_css_diagnostics
method.description: Returns the CSS declaration diagnostics associated with this element in the current layout. See [method HTMLLayout.get_css_diagnostics] for the dictionary fields.

method.name: get_dataset
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the element's [code]data-*[/code] attributes, using the same key conversion as HTML dataset. For example, [code]data-item-id[/code] becomes [code]itemId[/code].

method.name: get_inner_html
method.description: Serializes the current children as HTML, including text and comments. CSS-generated content is excluded. Escaping and attribute order can differ from the original source.

method.name: get_parent
method.description: Returns the parent element, or [code]null[/code] if this element has no parent.

method.name: get_tag_name
method.description: Returns the element's lowercase HTML tag name.

method.name: get_text_content
method.description: Concatenates the parsed text nodes in document order, including hidden content. Comments and CSS-generated text are excluded. For the laid-out text of the document, see [method HTMLLayout.get_plain_text].

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Returns whether the element has an attribute with the given name, including an empty attribute.

method.name: has_class
method.description: Returns whether the element has the given case-sensitive class name.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the handle still refers to an element in its original parsed layout.

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns whether this element matches the selector. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first matching descendant in document order, or [code]null[/code]. See [method query_selector_all] for the query scope.

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the matching descendants in document order, with each element included once. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element. Use [code]:scope > .title[/code] to select direct children with the given class. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector_all] for selector syntax.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes this element and its subtree from their parent and invalidates their handles. Calling this method on an unattached element with no parent leaves it available for insertion. The document root cannot be removed.

method.name: remove_attribute
method.description: Removes the named HTML attribute, if present. Attribute names are ASCII case-insensitive.

method.name: remove_class
method.description: Removes the given class name if present. See [method add_class] for the name rules.

method.name: set_attribute
method.description: Adds or updates the named HTML attribute. The value is stored as literal text. An empty value leaves the attribute present.

method.name: set_inner_html
method.description: Parses [param html] in the context of this element and replaces its children. The replaced descendants' handles become invalid. Empty HTML clears the children. Use [method set_text_content] to insert literal text.

method.name: set_text_content
method.description: Replaces the children with literal text and invalidates the replaced descendants' handles. Empty text clears the children.

method.name: toggle_class
method.description: Toggles the given class name when [param force] is [code]null[/code]. Pass [code]true[/code] to add it or [code]false[/code] to remove it. Use [method has_class] to read the resulting state.
